column1: # Language guard 2 exemptions: Chinese text in a src/main/java literal that is deliberately not routed
# through the language catalogue. One line per literal, three tab-separated fields:
#   path (relative to the module root) <TAB> the literal exactly as written between its quotes <TAB> reason
# Every line needs a reason. A line that no longer matches a literal fails the build (UltiWorldsCjkLiteralScopeTest).

column3: An accepted typed answer, not output: the world-creation wizard's structures prompt (StructuresPrompt) compares what the player types against this list, so a player may answer yes in Chinese as well as with y/yes/true/1 whatever the language setting. It is never shown
